title: Agent Installer CLI result
description: What `agent-installer plan|apply|remove --json` prints. Exit code 0: every client finished; 2: finished, but some components were left alone (see each client's problems); 1: failed (ok is false). scan and status print `clients` in the TargetScan and ClientStatus shapes of bindings/node/index.d.ts.

code.description: e.g. invalid_arguments, invalid_manifest, invalid_target, unknown_client, unsupported_platform, io_error.

actionCode.description: A stable code for a step left to the person, so a host can show its own wording. restart_client: quit and reopen the client. new_session: start a new session or conversation in the client. reload_config: reload the client's configuration or window. trust_hooks: review and trust the new or changed hooks in the client (Codex: /hooks). other: only the English message describes it (plain text from an extension file).

path.description: Shown relative to the home directory, e.g. ~/.claude.json.

action.description: adopt: an existing directory that already holds the product's files only gets its receipt.

note.description: How the change was made when that differs, e.g. a directory in use whose files were updated in place.

problems.description: Components left alone, with the reason.

actions.description: What the person still has to do, in English.

actionCodes.description: One code per entry of actions, in the same order.
